dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今日は連絡もないし、とっとと終わりにしよ
　う」
dialogues.en: "There's no announcements today, so I'd end HR now."
dialogues.text: "There's no announcements today, so I'd end HR now."

dialogues.jp:
教室に入ってくるなり、暦先生はそう言い、週
番を促す。
dialogues.en: As she left the classroom, the weekly duty quickly stood up.
dialogues.text: As she left the classroom, the weekly duty quickly stood up.

dialogues.jp:
週番が号令をだし、今日のＨＲは始まったとた
ん、終わった。
dialogues.en:
With just the announcement from the weekly duty, today's HR
ended as soon as it started.
dialogues.text:
With just the announcement from the weekly duty, today's HR
ended as soon as it started.

dialogues.jp: 「さ〜て……今日はなにをして帰ろうかな」
dialogues.en: "Now then... how will I go back today."
dialogues.text: "Now then... how will I go back today."

dialogues.jp: 腕を上に伸ばしながら、自問するように呟く。
dialogues.en: I stretch my arms above my head as I question myself.
dialogues.text: I stretch my arms above my head as I question myself.

dialogues.jp:
放課後、教室に入ってきた暦先生の第一声は、
『とっとと終わりにしよう』だった。
dialogues.en:
After school, Koyomi-sensei started the HR session and
immediately said that she'd end it.
dialogues.text:
After school, Koyomi-sensei started the HR session and
immediately said that she'd end it.
